description:
Review a package upgrade: vulnerabilities, releases, peers, dependency changes. Compares current and target versions, including target deprecation and optional transitive evidence diffs. Reports facts only: classified release-note statements in source order with nearby URLs and coverage, not package-level risk or an accept decision. Use this instead of inferring acceptability from semver, including patch bumps; start assessments here and add pkg_changelog or code_diff only for missing details. Preserve generated-from-commits labels and pending/unavailable status; generated statements are not publisher notes. Batches default to triage rows; verbose expands per-package evidence. Single mode: registry/package_name/current_version/target_version; batch: packages[] (at most 30).

Load the GitHits guide once per session first (`quick_start` or the `githits-mcp` skill).

changes.description: Filter detailed statement quotes only: actionable (MUST_ACT), important (MUST_ACT + SHOULD_KNOW), or all parsed units, including no-impact and unassessed. Omit or pass blank to use focused (MUST_ACT + SHOULD_KNOW + too-long-to-classify (oversize) statements). Whole-range counters and batch ranking do not change.

current_version.description: Currently used version for single-package mode. Go accepts versions with or without its canonical v prefix; tag-style v prefixes are rejected for other registries except Swift.

format.description: Omit for text. Use json only when code consumes raw fields or text lacks a required field. JSON includes selected statement pages, source positions/context and classifier provenance.

include_dependency_issues.description: When true, diff current vs target transitive deprecated/outdated/duplicate/conflict summaries. Defaults false.

min_severity.description: Minimum direct-advisory severity: low, medium, high, or critical.

packages.description: Batch mode with at most 30 upgrades after blank rows are removed. Mutually exclusive with single-package fields.

current_version.description: Current version; see top-level current_version for spelling rules.

registry.description: Registry; see top-level registry for supported values.

target_version.description: Target version; see top-level current_version for spelling rules.

registry.description: Package registry for single-package mode. Supported: npm, pypi, hex, crates, nuget, maven, zig, vcpkg, packagist, rubygems, go, swift, pub.

skip_transitive_security.description: When true, skip current-vs-target transitive vulnerability summary diffs. Defaults false, so transitive security evidence is included unless explicitly skipped.

target_version.description: Target version for single-package mode; spelling rules as current_version.

verbose.description: Text output only. Batches default to triage rows; verbose adds full per-package reports, expands statement quotes up to backend bounds, and expands dependency change examples.

name: pkg_upgrade_review
